title: The Hero Who Can Only Climb When She Tells the Truth
sources: Fiction. Original hero 'Nova Wren'. The reveal uses the everyday idea that nervous hands sweat and wet fingertips lose grip.

lines.text: In this city, the hero sticks to skyscrapers, but only when she tells the truth.
Her name was Nova Wren, and tonight she had one job:
stop the Glitch Bandit, before sunrise.
He'd stolen every clock in the city.
Without clocks, even the bakery opened at midnight.
Nova climbed his tower, super easy.
Then he shouted, are you scared?
She said, nope, not at all!
And slid down three floors.
Wait, what? She tried again. I'm totally fine!
Slipped again. Straight into a trash can.
Now her whole costume smelled like old pizza.
Then it got worse.
Everyone on the street was filming.
The mayor said, fix this, or lose the mask.
By sunrise she was hanging off the top, with one hand left.
A hundred metres up, wind howling, and the bandit just waved.
So she said the one honest thing.
I'm scared. I'm really, really scared.
And her hand stuck, like glue.
See, lies make you nervous, and nervous palms sweat.
Wet fingers slip. Honest, dry fingers grip.
She caught him, and kept her mask.
Which is why, in this city, the hero only sticks when she tells the truth.
